arms: full rollout-policy-improvement over Experiment C's candidate universe
arms_note: Six, frozen. h_phi-top2, direct h_phi override, random proposals and all-successor ranking are deliberately excluded: redundant, or a different question. No arm may be added after this run.
primary_endpoint: exact target recovery within the declared budget

H1.statement: R_full > R_greedy -- future-aware verification rescues myopic failures
H1.reporting: Lead with paired effect size and uncertainty, NOT a McNemar p-value: the verified controller is CONSTRUCTED to retain greedy's option, so the one-sided discordance is structural and a p-value would dress a design property as a finding.

H2.statement: sim2 + verified rollout is THE preregistered efficient controller, selected on the 24 for exact-target recovery
H2.reporting: Report gain retention (R_sim2-R_greedy)/(R_full-R_greedy) AND the actual rescue-set overlap. The 24 showed these are NOT interchangeable: hphi1 retained 5/6 in magnitude but only 4/6 of full's actual rescues, plus one full itself missed.

h_phi_role: SECONDARY learned-prioritisation arm. 'h_phi beats similarity' is explicitly NOT a hypothesis -- the 24 did not establish it (3-vs-2 discordant at K=1, p=0.50). The question is only whether learned future-value information can serve as a useful proposal signal under verified control. If it ties similarity again, that is a complete answer for this task.
not_evidence_against_learned_desirabilit: A similarity win would show exact-target recovery is a poor test bed for learned desirability -- the goal IS a molecule, so Tanimoto-to-the-answer is privileged. No such heuristic exists for property conjunctions, pathwise constraints, or mid-trajectory retargeting.
terminology: 'full' is full-remaining-budget ROLLOUT EVALUATION under a greedy base policy -- a rollout policy-improvement controller, NOT globally optimal dynamic programming over the rewrite graph.
stopping_rule: Whatever happens is the answer. No threshold changes, no new K, no dropping difficult pairs, no new model, no rerun.
